header.userPrompt: Add a sample of Scala3 Match types

resultJson.title: Add Scala 3 match types sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `matchtypes/MatchTypes.scala`, a runnable sample of Scala 3 match types, requested as "Add a sample of Scala3 Match types".

It covers three cases: a simple `Elem[X]` match type used by `firstElem`, a recursive `Leaf[X]` that flattens nested lists, and a type-level `Len[T]` over tuples. `matchTypesDemo` is a `@main` that prints results for each.

The diff also includes `.bsp/sbt.json` and `.orca/` files (run progress and settings), which are tooling files, not part of the sample.
